inv16_frame_analysis.artifact_prefetch_observation: ARTIFACT_PREFETCH frames reached the non-capable node because AppManager.Deploy calls ArtifactManager.PrefetchToNodes for the whole requested node list before the per-node Capability check. The prefetch only populates the Agent artifact cache; no Host Operation (DEPLOY_REQUEST) was dispatched. Recorded as an observation, not a case failure; the client-side artifact cache rows below are the only trace.
